item.note:
F 296 is a slightly (ca. 2 fols.) longer version of the sutra contained in the Rat+nakuta collection; it's title is given as Rastrapala (ra sta pa la)-m.s./ Pho brang 'khor skyong zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo, without the additions Arya/'Phags paandthe usual introduction for titles in this collection: 'Phags pa dKon brtsegs pa bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las. It has no colophon.
L 122 contains almost 10 folios more than 643.18andgives the title as Arya Pustupala-pariprccha n.m.s./'Phags pa Yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo, without the introduction 'Phags pa dKon brtsegs pa bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las. Its colophon is identical to that in Go.
